firstPlayerRule: For a standalone multiplayer game of Episode 2, whoever most recently went on a nature adventure goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Preliminary Settlement or Camp placement and its associated benefits run counterclockwise, beginning with the last player.
Episode 1 uses a different criterion. This entry does not cover the separate Chronicle campaign or solo mode.
